title: Implement TypeScript string utility functions
description: Implement four string utilities in TypeScript: slugify, truncate, wordCount, and capitalize. A Jest test suite is provided.

task_spec.prompt:
Create src/strings.ts exporting four string utility functions:

  export function slugify(text: string): string
    — lowercase, replace spaces/non-alphanumeric with hyphens, collapse multiple hyphens, trim leading/trailing hyphens

  export function truncate(text: string, maxLength: number): string
    — if text.length <= maxLength return text; otherwise return text.slice(0, maxLength - 3) + '...'

  export function wordCount(text: string): number
    — split on whitespace, return count of non-empty tokens

  export function capitalize(text: string): string
    — uppercase first character, leave rest unchanged; empty string -> empty string

All 13 tests in tests/strings.test.ts must pass.
Run: npm test
required_artifacts: wordCount handles multiple spaces and empty string
followup_prompts: Run `npm test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `npm test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
